goal.question: Lark Basin sold fewer units in the latest fortnight. Investigate where the decline is concentrated, weigh the most relevant explanations, and report what the available evidence can establish.

sql: WITH panel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE entity = 'Lark Basin') AS source WHERE (day >= '2025-06-01' AND day < '2025-06-15') OR (day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29')) SELECT period, SUM(units) AS units FROM panel GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH panel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE entity = 'Lark Basin') AS source WHERE (day >= '2025-06-01' AND day < '2025-06-15') OR (day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29')) SELECT period, 'sku' AS axis, sku AS key, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(complaints) AS complaints
            FROM panel GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 UNION ALL
            SELECT period, 'region', region, SUM(units), SUM(complaints) FROM panel GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 UNION ALL SELECT period, 'cell', sku || '_' || region, SUM(units), SUM(complaints)
                FROM panel GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

WITH panel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE entity = 'Alder Tern') AS source WHERE (day >= '2025-06-01' AND day < '2025-06-15') OR (day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29')) SELECT period, 'sku' AS axis, sku AS key, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(complaints) AS complaints
            FROM panel GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 UNION ALL
            SELECT period, 'region', region, SUM(units), SUM(complaints) FROM panel GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 UNION ALL SELECT period, 'cell', sku || '_' || region, SUM(units), SUM(complaints)
                FROM panel GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

sql:
WITH panel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE entity = 'Alder Tern') AS source WHERE (day >= '2025-06-01' AND day < '2025-06-15') OR (day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29')) SELECT period, AVG(available) AS availability, COUNT(available) AS recorded,
            COUNT(*) AS panel_rows, SUM(units) AS units, SUM(CASE WHEN switched THEN units END) AS switched_units
            FROM (SELECT *, MIN(available) FILTER (WHERE period = 0) OVER (PARTITION BY sku,region) = 1
              AND MAX(available) FILTER (WHERE period = 1) OVER (PARTITION BY sku,region) = 0 AS switched
              FROM panel) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH panel AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS period FROM (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE entity = 'Reed Lantern' AND sku = 'core' AND region = 'north') AS source WHERE (day >= '2025-06-01' AND day < '2025-06-15') OR (day >= '2025-06-15' AND day < '2025-06-29')) SELECT period, CASE WHEN COUNT(available) = COUNT(*) THEN AVG(available) END AS availability, COUNT(available) AS recorded,
